identity.name: E1
identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

usage_rules: CRITICAL: Use Primary (#6200ee) ONLY for key actions (Primary Buttons, Active States, Important Links).
Sidebar MUST be dark (#0f172a) to provide contrast with the light content area.
Content area background should be white or very light gray (#f8fafc).
Text must be Slate-900 (Headings) and Slate-600 (Body) for optimal readability.
Success/Error colors should be vibrant but used sparingly (badges, toast borders).

layout.structure: Sidebar Navigation + Top Header + Main Content Area

grid_system.list_views: Single Column Card Layout or Table View

sidebar.behavior: Fixed on Desktop, Drawer on Mobile

inputs.classes: h-10 rounded-lg border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#6200ee] focus:border-transparent

navigation.item_classes: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors

visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle, distinct shadows. Example: shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]
visual_enhancers.borders: Crisp 1px borders in slate-200. No thick outlines.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Buttons scale down slightly on click (active:scale-95). Links fade on hover.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only on sticky headers or overlays (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80).

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup Theme: Update tailwind.config.js with the #6200ee primary color and slate palette.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Create Layout: Build the SidebarLayout component using the Sidebar guidelines (Fixed left, responsive).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Dashboard Page: Implement the 'Bento Grid' layout for Analytics using Recharts and Cards.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Data Tables: Build a reusable DataTable component (Shadcn Table) with Pagination, Filtering, and Sorting for Categories/Products.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Forms: Use Shadcn Form + Zod for Create/Edit modals/drawers. Styling must match 'inputs' guidelines.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Settings: Create a clean list/tab view for Settings pages.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, keep it flat and clean.
Ensure high contrast: Text on white bg must be slate-900 or slate-600.
Spacing is key: Use 'p-8' or 'gap-6' to let data breathe.
Animations: Use 'framer-motion' for page transitions and list entry animations.
Tables should not look like spreadsheets. Use generous padding (py-4) and clear typography.
